caption: The drawing depicts a tall, cylindrical stoneware jug with a wide mouth and two rounded handles attached near the top on opposite sides. The jug is primarily a beige or light tan color with several blue decorative markings and motifs. Near the upper third of the jug, there is a band of wavy lines and spots in blue. The central area of the jug is adorned with a blue, stylized image of an eagle with outstretched wings, clutching arrows and an olive branch in its talons, accompanied by letters and partially visible words, including “GREENSBORO, PA.” Additional blue embellishments appear near the base of the jug, with a number "3" surrounded by foliage-like blue patterns. The background of the drawing is a uniform pale beige color, and the artist’s signature, "John Tarantino," is visible in small print in the lower right corner.
title: Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
